title: scriptfs module manifest
description: Describes a ScriptFS module: its entry point and the host resources it needs inside the container.

name.description: Module name, shown in errors and logs.

entry.description: JavaScript entry file relative to this manifest. It must stay inside the module directory.

export.description: Export of the entry file to use: a class constructed with the module runtime, or a provider object.

settings.description: Non-secret configuration values. Instances set them under modules.<name>.settings.

propertyNames.description: Letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter.

default.description: Value used when the instance does not set the setting.

required.description: Whether instances must set a value when there is no default.

secrets.description: Sensitive values read on the host when the session starts and handed to the module without being written to the configuration.

propertyNames.description: Letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter.

env.description: Environment variable read when the instance does not configure a source.

ports.description: Network connections between the module and the host.

propertyNames.description: Letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter.

oneOf.description: The module connects to a service on the host through a ScriptFS tunnel.

target.description: Default host:port on the host. Instances can override it.

oneOf.description: The module listens in the container; the port is published on 127.0.0.1 of the host.

port.description: Container port the module listens on.

hostPort.description: Default host port. Defaults to port; instances can override it.

paths.description: Host files or directories mounted into the container.

propertyNames.description: Letters, digits, _ and -; starts with a letter.

required.description: Optional paths are skipped when they are not configured and their default does not exist.

default.description: Host path used when the instance does not configure one: absolute or starting with ~/.

state.description: Whether the module gets a persistent, writable state directory.

dependencies.description: How npm dependencies reach the container. "bundled": the module directory already contains everything it imports. "install": ScriptFS runs `npm ci --omit=dev --omit=peer` inside the runtime image from the module's package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json or package-lock.json, caches the result, and mounts it as the module's node_modules.
